resources.string: Start your journey with SAA 2025. Log in to explore!
KUDOS RECIPIENTS: HERO BADGES FOR POSITIVE IMPACT
Based on how many teammates send you Kudos, you earn the matching Hero badge, shown right next to your profile name.
More than 20 people have sent you Kudos
The journey of spreading good begins – your first thank-yous and recognitions have found their way to you.
You have become a trusted and beloved icon, always ready to help and remembered by many teammates.
KUDOS SENDERS: COLLECT ALL 6 ICONS TO RECEIVE A MYSTERY GIFT
Each Kudos you post earns ❤️ from the Sunner community. For every 5 ❤️, you open 1 Secret Box for a chance to receive 1 of 6 exclusive SAA icons.
Sunners who collect the full set of 6 icons will receive a mystery gift from SAA 2025.
The 5 Kudos with the most ❤️ across all of Sun* officially become National Kudos and receive a special gift from SAA 2025: Root Further.
